decisions.briefing: NASDAQ and S&P 500 both ticked up +0.4% today — a neutral, low-conviction session. With cash at $289.29 (below the $500 buy threshold) and no strong risk-on signal, we're holding all 7 positions and keeping the 3 open slots in reserve rather than forcing a trade.

market_education.summary_en: Markets drifted modestly higher today, with both the NASDAQ and S&P 500 up 0.4%, reflecting a lack of strong catalysts in either direction. Trading stayed range-bound as investors awaited clearer signals before committing new capital. This kind of low-volatility, low-volume drift is typical of consolidation phases between bigger moves.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市走勢平穩，納指及標普500指數同步上升0.4%，市場缺乏明顯的方向性催化劑。投資者在等待更清晰的訊號之前，普遍採取觀望態度，成交量亦相對溫和。這種低波動、低成交的格局，通常是大行情之間的整固階段。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a genuinely strong opportunity appears. Holding cash on a quiet, neutral day instead of forcing a trade isn't inaction — it's discipline that preserves capital for higher-conviction setups.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指預留在場邊、隨時可動用的現金。在市況平淡的日子裡按兵不動、不勉強交易，並非消極，而是一種紀律，讓資金留待更高勝算的機會出現時再出手。
